protocol.primary_penalty_interpretation: log(12): prior odds 12:1 for original ID versus any one alternative
protocol.scope: fixed independent sites; cached site-specific top3+original; no geographic search or cross-site proposals
protocol.selection: multi-start coordinate ascent of empirical-prior shared-satellite timing training evidence minus change penalty
protocol.scoring: conditional empirical-prior predictive NLL with selected IDs; penalty affects training selection only, not evaluation score
